description: This Java interface defines the configuration schema for streaming functionalities in the Eclipse Ditto gateway services, including methods to retrieve various configuration parameters such as intervals, timeouts, and nested configs.

classes.name: StreamingConfig
classes.description: Interface defining the configuration parameters for gateway streaming features, including methods for retrieving intervals, timeouts, and nested configs, as well as a default render method.

classes.name: StreamingConfig.StreamingConfigValue
classes.description: An enum listing known configuration keys and their default values used within the StreamingConfig configuration schema.

methods.name: getSessionCounterScrapeInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for updating the session counter.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration related to acknowledgements in gateway streaming sessions.

methods.name: getWebsocketConfig
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket configuration for streaming.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of stream elements to process in parallel.

methods.name: getSearchIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for closing idle search streams.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Converts the current configuration into a Config object for serialization or further processing.
